A little about me.

I’m a Master of Design student at NIFT Bengaluru with a background in English Literature and an interest in understanding how people interact with the world around them.

I approach design through curiosity, research, and experimentation. Whether I’m working on a digital experience, a brand identity, or a service, I’m interested in understanding the problem before jumping into the solution.

My interests span UX and interaction design, brand strategy, visual communication, and service design. I enjoy connecting research and strategic thinking with expressive visual outcomes.

My experience includes working on brand communication and marketing design for Sri Sri Wellbeing, developing digital experiences, and exploring research-led design solutions across different contexts.

I believe good design should make sense, work beautifully, and bring a little joy into people’s lives.

I’m always curious about how things work, why people behave the way they do, and how thoughtful design can make everyday experiences better.

  • UX & interaction design
  • Brand strategy
  • Visual communication
  • Service design

Making sense of complexity. Bringing joy to the experience.
